text:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — I'm rolling a refresh of the preemptible pool ops playbook. Need a final pass on drain + interruption handling before I push automation changes.
Priya Singh: Thanks Alex. Main goals? cheaper baseline but stable SLAs?
Alex Chen: Exactly. We want to keep 60-70% spot usage on training/async workloads while guaranteeing low-latency inference via a small on-demand baseline.
Jordan Park: Key ask: make the drain path deterministic. Right now we sometimes lose ~15s of in-flight KV cache which spikes tail latency.
Alex Chen: Agreed. Plan: cordon -> graceful drain with preempt hook that migrates KV shards + quick fallback to on-demand pool.
Taylor Rivera: Example commands for runbook?
Alex Chen: Add this to the ops section: 
```
# cordon node
kubectl cordon gpu-node-123
# drain with pod eviction grace and skip-daemonsets
kubectl drain gpu-node-123 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
```
Priya Singh: Also include the preemptible lifecycle hook we added in the autoscaler, so drains trigger early cache flush: `preempt-hook: /opt/inference/flush-kv.sh --target 10s`
Jordan Park: For mixed pools, note we prefer binpack on spot, spread on on-demand. Helps avoid hot shards during failover.
Alex Chen: Escalation path in my draft:
- page `sre-oncall` if drain fails to complete in 3m
- page `#eng-infra` and @Taylor Rivera if node rejoin fails
- open ticket with cloud-ops for region capacity issues (include provider request id)
Add it as a table.
infra-bot: [automation] scheduled job `spot-drain-checker` will run every 30s and post results to #eng-infra.
Priya Singh: Cost guidance: prefer cheaper preemptible families (A2/GPU-v2) for non-latency jobs, but cap spot bid by dynamic market index. Add command to query index: `curl -s https://cost-index.internal/spot | jq`
Alex Chen: Recovery playbook snippet:
```
# if pods rescheduled to on-demand pool
kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector=status.phase=Pending
# rebind heavy KV-serving pods to on-demand via nodeSelector patch
kubectl patch pod my-kv-pod -p '{"spec":{"nodeSelector":{"instance-type":"on-demand"}}}'
```
Taylor Rivera: Add a note: when region-wide preempt rate > 40% for 10m, auto-fallback to reserved capacity (60% of baseline) and notify sales for potential SLAs.
Jordan Park: Tests to add: chaos preempt script that kills 3% of spot nodes and measures 99.9th latency. Put under `infra/chaos/spot-sim` CI job.
Alex Chen: Final: I'll update the doc and link the terraform module for mixed-instance groups and the autoscaler policy. Ping me in-thread if you see wording issues. :eyes: :+1:
sre-oncall: Will monitor tonight; set pager thresholds to 5% failed drains per minute.
Priya Singh: Thanks — I'll proof the wording on escalation and add the contact numbers for cloud-ops.
Alex Chen: Cool — merging draft after changes. Leaving TODOs inline for follow-up.
